title: Provider Factory with Lazy Plugin Entry Points
instructions: In `provfac.py`, implement `ProviderFactory`: a decorator-based registry of built-in providers plus plugin entry points that are recorded without importing, loaded exactly once on first use (even under concurrent first use), never allowed to replace a built-in, and isolated when broken (`ProviderLoadError` chained from the cause).

evidence.label: register() returns the builder unchanged and create() passes kwargs
An unknown name raises UnknownProviderError listing the known names
Registering a duplicate name raises ValueError
Plugins are recorded without loading and loaded exactly once
names() lists built-ins and pending plugins, sorted
A broken plugin raises a chained ProviderLoadError and nothing else breaks
A plugin cannot replace a built-in and a warning is logged
The earlier plugin wins over a later one with the same name
Eight concurrent first calls load the plugin exactly once
